FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Petal & Stem Florists, we specialize in providing high-quality floral arrangements for a variety of occasions, including weddings, corporate events, and everyday celebrations. Our operations are firmly rooted in compliance with local regulations, as we maintain all required business licenses to ensure legal operation. Our team takes pride in sourcing fresh flowers from reputable suppliers and our fleet is equipped for safe and secure delivery, adhering to best practices in packaging and route planning to minimize damage during transport. We also conduct regular risk assessments and customer satisfaction monitoring, ensuring our services meet the highest standards. Additionally, for any offsite setups, we conduct thorough event site safety assessments, addressing any potential risks proactively. With a commitment to quality and safety, we strive to exceed customer expectations while maintaining operational excellence.

Our florist shop regularly operates in a manner that includes utilizing temporary permits for events and seasonal sales, which we believe allows us to meet local demand while providing beautiful arrangements.
